standing_rule: SHARE THE RECORD, NEVER SHARE THE CLAIM
letters_key: LETTERS KEY v1.1: take the string's canonical decomposition (Unicode NFD), then keep only U+05D0–U+05EA, in order. Applies to every headword, every ink word, every key, every index, every shard.
exact_reading: EXACT READING: the bytes of the reading a per-place source gives for the WHOLE ink word at a place — TAHOT: the record's R (column 4, as received) of the word's line; MACULA: the reading piece store v2's WHOLE_WORD claim rebuilds for that word (english-else-gloss of the word's rows, as the piece store RULE writes it). Where a reading is a list, each element is its own exact reading. Two readings are the same row only if their bytes are equal.
page_numbering: PAGE NUMBERING: the word number the page uses — the served zones' numbering (each Tanakh book's zone from https://fireandhail.com/reader/data/zones/<name>.bin, named in https://fireandhail.com/reader/data/zone-store-v1.json; decode the format as the served engine https://fireandhail.com/reader/engine-d60445a76ff9.js reads it): marks not counted, each maqaf piece a word. w_page is that number; w_lane is the word numbering ledger's / piece store v2's w; the map (book, ref, w_lane) → w_page is a file.
shard_rule: the first two hex of the lowercase sha256 of the key's UTF-8 bytes
key_rule: every non-empty LETTERS KEY v1.1 of a headword of a record, and every letters of a line of index/readings-by-letters.jsonl; no key ""
language_at_a_place: LANGUAGE AT A PLACE, per source: TAHOT — read from the morphology column of the word's own line by the file's legend; MACULA — the lang column of the word's own row(s); value HEBREW | ARAMAIC | the source's own value if neither; a place where the two sources differ is listed [places].

language_rules.tahot: THE TAHOT RULE: the word's line is the line the piece store record names (file, line, 1-based, LF-split, a trailing CR removed); its column 6 (1-based; "Grammar" of the header line) is the morphology; the value is HEBREW when the column's first character is "H", ARAMAIC when it is "A", else the column's own bytes as the value. The line's own bytes are asserted equal to the record's D.
language_rules.macula: THE MACULA RULE: the word's rows are the rows the piece store records name (file, line, 1-based); the value of each row's lang column (column 17, 1-based) is HEBREW when it is "H", ARAMAIC when it is "A", else the column's own bytes. The row's bytes are asserted equal to the record's D.
language_rules.several_values: several values at one place are sorted by UTF-8 bytes and joined by "|" (LANG_MIXED_AT_A_PLACE, listed)
legend_lines: TAHOT: "Grammar	Morphology is from ETCBC, with Ketiv forms parsed by Tyndale scholars - see e.g. Deu.33.2-15.   For the source of ETCBC and conversion method by Tyndale House, see https://goo.gl/yKaXQq#HebMorph2"
TAHOT: "	Morphology codes follow the form defined by OpenScriptures at http://openscriptures.github.io/morphhb/parsing/HebrewMorphologyCodes.html#vt with some adaptations - see TinyURL.com/HebMorph"

TAHOT header: "Eng (Heb) Ref & Type	Hebrew	Transliteration	Translation	dStrongs	Grammar	Meaning Variants	Spelling Variants	Root dStrong+Instance	Alternative Strongs+Instance	Conjoin word	Expanded Strong tags"
TAHOT in-file example: "#_Word+Grammar	H9003/H7225G=HR/Ncfsa	H1254A=HVqp3ms	…" — the code after "=" begins with the language letter
